description: The graph illustrates the similarity of head-wise attention (HSA) patterns across different languages in the Qwen1.5-1.8B model, measured as a function of the model layer. The x-axis represents the layer number, ranging from 0 to 22, while the y-axis shows the similarity score, ranging from 0.00 to 0.45. Four distinct language pairs are plotted: en&en (red), en&es (blue), en&el (green), and en&bn (purple), each represented by a colored line. The similarity scores for all language pairs exhibit a general trend of increasing from layer 0 to a peak around layer 6, where the en&en pair reaches the highest similarity of approximately 0.26. After this peak, the similarity values decline gradually across the layers, with all lines converging to low similarity values (around 0.05–0.07) between layers 16 and 20. A sharp increase in similarity is observed for all language pairs from layer 21 to 22, with the en&en pair reaching the highest similarity of approximately 0.43 at layer 22. The en&es and en&el pairs show similar trends, while the en&bn pair remains consistently lower in similarity throughout the layers.
